**Original comment by europlatus (Bitbucket: [europlatus](https://bitbucket.org/europlatus), GitHub: [europlatus](https://github.com/europlatus)).**

----------------------------------------

I can confirm that the TooWa themes _**do not**_ have this issue. However, there are some other graphical issues, namely some of the elements don’t properly “ungrey” when the mask is first activated or appear in a darker grey than other elements. Pressing the mask “power button” on and off resolves this issue. I have not found a pattern to it yet, although it seems to happen on the very first activation of the tool/mask or when you activate the mask power button before expanding the mask.

![](https://bitbucket.org/repo/9pArXyE/images/3837679259-image.png)
![](https://bitbucket.org/repo/9pArXyE/images/1218035792-image.png)
